title: bosun decision, schema 6
description: One decision. Changes from v5: supersedes says how much of the earlier entry it replaces. A whole-entry link was dropping rules that still hold, because an entry often replaces one part of an earlier decision and leaves the rest in force. Compression has to know the difference or it removes live rules.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier, never reused and never changed. New entries use a UTC timestamp formatted YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS-mmm-utc, for example 2026-08-28-17-16-23-456-utc. Entries from schema v1 carry a slug instead. Hyphens only, so the id is safe in filenames, URLs and shell arguments on every platform.

alias.description: Short human label such as E18. Typed by people in prose.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the decision was made.

origin.description: Project the decision came from. Required so knowledge can travel and stay checkable.

author_role.description: Role, not person. The log answers why it is so, never who was wrong.

quote.description: The triggering sentence, verbatim, in the language it was said in.

rejected.description: The alternatives that lost, and why. Without these the same option gets reconsidered next time.

reason_type.description: Unglamorous values are first-class. Countable, so the claim that honest entries exist can be checked.

falsifier.description: What one would observe to know this was wrong. Required: without it the log is an archive.

id.description: id or alias of the earlier entry

extent.description: whole: nothing of the earlier entry survives. part: only the named aspect is replaced, the rest still holds.

detail.description: For extent part: what exactly was replaced, and by implication what still stands.

supersedes.description: What this entry replaces, and how much of it. Compression drops a rule only for extent whole.
